## Problem and change

Describe what triggered the problem and how behavior changes.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and their results. For performance changes, include comparable measurements and fidelity effects.

- [ ] Targets `develop`, or explains a release/hotfix targeting `main`.
- [ ] Includes a regression test when behavior changes, or explains why one is unnecessary.
- [ ] Uses only invented or redistributable fixtures; no private data, sensitive locations or credentials.
- [ ] Updates documentation for changed behavior or requirements.
